title: How is Franklin D. Roosevelt connected to Lee Jung-jae?
description:
Four real photos connect Franklin D. Roosevelt to Squid Game star Lee Jung-jae.

Franklin D. Roosevelt → George VI → Elizabeth II → Emmanuel Macron → Lee Jung-jae

How they're connected (every photo is real and sourced):
1. Franklin D. Roosevelt → George VI: In 1939, Roosevelt took King George the Sixth sailing, on the first American visit by a reigning British king.
   Photo by Harris & Ewing, photographer, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:The_Roosevelts_with_the_King_and_Queen_of_England_sailing_on_the_USS_Potomac,_June_9,_1939_(cropped).jpg
2. George VI → Queen Elizabeth II: During World War Two, the King met RAF bomber crews with his daughter, Princess Elizabeth.
   Photo by Royal Air Force official photographer, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Royal_Air_Force_Bomber_Command,_1942-1945._CH20901.jpg
3. Queen Elizabeth II → Emmanuel Macron: As Queen, in 2021 she hosted Emmanuel Macron and the other G7 leaders in Cornwall.
   Photo by Number 10, CC BY 2.0: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Prime_Minister_Boris_Johnson_G7_Summit_Day_One_-_51242021245.jpg
4. Emmanuel Macron → Lee Jung-jae: And in 2025, Macron posed with Squid Game star Lee Jung-jae at a charity gala in Paris.
   Photo by Lee Jung-jae (Instagram), via Hankyung, Fair use (commentary): https://www.hankyung.com/article/2025013040447

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.

#franklindroosevelt #leejungjae #sixdegrees #history #didyouknow #shorts
